body_lead: Gandhinagar: Gujarat govt on Monday signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with automation and artificial intelligence company Automation Anywhere to strengthen the stateâs AI ecosystem, with the company committing around Rs 100 crore over the next 10 years towards youth training, capacity building and AI-related initiatives. The MoU was signed by department of science and technology (DST) in the presence of science and technology minister Arjun Modhwadia .
